operations.name: Build DUPR payloads and check eligibility

options.sql:
WITH submissions AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(?::jsonb) AS s(val)
),
vals AS (
  SELECT
    s.val->>'matchKey' AS match_key,
    s.val->>'status' AS status,
    (s.val->>'duprMatchCode') AS dupr_code,
    (s.val->>'duprHashedMatchCode') AS dupr_hashed,
    (s.val->>'error') AS error_msg,
    ?::uuid AS submitted_by,
    ? AS env,
    ?::timestamptz AS ts,
    ?::uuid AS club_id
  FROM submissions s
)
INSERT INTO dupr_submission (id, match_key, status, club, dupr_match_code, dupr_hashed_match_code, error_message, submitted_by, submitted_at, environment, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT gen_random_uuid(), match_key, status, club_id, dupr_code, dupr_hashed, error_msg, submitted_by,
  CASE WHEN status = 'submitted' THEN ts ELSE NULL END,
  env, ts, ts
FROM vals
ON CONFLICT (match_key)
DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  club = EXCLUDED.club,
  dupr_match_code = EXCLUDED.dupr_match_code,
  dupr_hashed_match_code = EXCLUDED.dupr_hashed_match_code,
  error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message,
  submitted_by = EXCLUDED.submitted_by,
  submitted_at = EXCLUDED.submitted_at,
  updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at;

UPDATE dupr_credentials 
SET access_token = ?, 
    refresh_token = ?, 
    access_expires_at = ?::timestamptz, 
    refresh_expires_at = ?::timestamptz, 
    updated_at = NOW() 
WHERE id = ?::uuid;

UPDATE dupr_connection 
SET singles_rating = ?, 
    doubles_rating = ?, 
    rating_updated_at = ?::timestamptz 
WHERE dupr_id = ?;

WITH vals AS (
  SELECT ?::uuid AS user_id, ? AS dupr_id, ? AS env, NULLIF(?, '')::numeric AS s_rating, NULLIF(?, '')::numeric AS d_rating, ?::timestamptz AS ts, NULLIF(?, '')::json AS elig, NULLIF(?, '')::timestamptz AS elig_ts
)
INSERT INTO dupr_connection (id, "user", dupr_id, environment, status, singles_rating, doubles_rating, rating_updated_at, connected_at, disconnected_at, eligibility, eligibility_checked_at)
SELECT gen_random_uuid(), user_id, dupr_id, env, 'connected', s_rating, d_rating, ts, ts, NULL, elig, elig_ts
FROM vals
ON CONFLICT ("user")
DO UPDATE SET
  dupr_id = EXCLUDED.dupr_id,
  status = 'connected',
  singles_rating = EXCLUDED.singles_rating,
  doubles_rating = EXCLUDED.doubles_rating,
  rating_updated_at = EXCLUDED.rating_updated_at,
  connected_at = EXCLUDED.connected_at,
  disconnected_at = NULL,
  eligibility = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.eligibility, dupr_connection.eligibility),
  eligibility_checked_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.eligibility_checked_at, dupr_connection.eligibility_checked_at);

WITH vals AS (
  SELECT ?::uuid AS user_id, ? AS env, ? AS access_token, ? AS refresh_token, ?::timestamptz AS access_exp, ?::timestamptz AS refresh_exp, ?::timestamptz AS ts
)
INSERT INTO dupr_credentials (id, connection, access_token, refresh_token, access_expires_at, refresh_expires_at, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT gen_random_uuid(),
  (SELECT id FROM dupr_connection WHERE "user" = vals.user_id),
  vals.access_token, vals.refresh_token, vals.access_exp, vals.refresh_exp, vals.ts, vals.ts
FROM vals
ON CONFLICT (connection)
DO UPDATE SET
  access_token = EXCLUDED.access_token,
  refresh_token = EXCLUDED.refresh_token,
  access_expires_at = EXCLUDED.access_expires_at,
  refresh_expires_at = EXCLUDED.refresh_expires_at,
  updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at;
UPDATE directus_users SET dupr_id = ? WHERE id = ?::uuid;

/* UPDATE directus_users SET rating = 1450 WHERE id = 'be90e5a7-6c48-4d7e-ae9d-747cdf008387'; */
UPDATE directus_users SET rating = 1450;
UPDATE dupr_connection SET status = 'disconnected', disconnected_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?::uuid;
DELETE FROM dupr_credentials WHERE connection = ?::uuid;
UPDATE directus_users SET dupr_id = NULL WHERE id = ?::uuid;
